releaseStatus: evaluation-ready release candidate; technical verification complete for the bounded questionnaire profile, reviewed Qualtrics QSF and LimeSurvey LSS import, and Qualtrics bridge 0.8.7-q7; novice-conductor and questionnaire-user evaluation pending
revisionPolicy: Use the immutable Git commit or release tag named in this file. Do not move an existing tag after a functional or evidence change.
storageMode: local fallback or exact-origin UCL Qualtrics bridge; central collection becomes active only after approved survey setup and synthetic cross-device verification
claimBoundary: Questionnaire-independent within the published integer single-choice profile and allowlisted workflows/scorers. The no-code and reviewed-import paths support 1-20 items on one shared integer scale with mean, sum and optional reverse scoring. The platform is not compatible with every questionnaire and does not establish permission, psychometric validity, equivalence, full WCAG conformance or disability-group benefit.
historicalBaseline: Version 0.7 remains available at source/demo/accessible-nasa-tlx-v0.7.html and in Git history.
evaluationStatus: Ready for bounded formative evaluation; participant evidence has not yet been collected.
